method.account: Separate synthetic QA account created through regular registration; credentials omitted

method.player: Real just_audio/AVPlayer; 30–45 ms position stream, three complete playback speeds, paused seek
method.lag: First cue event position minus cue start divided by speed; wall milliseconds, not acoustic alignment error
method.harness_note: First probe passed API checks but checked a stale completed player state during replay. Harness now pauses and waits for completed-to-ready before starting each replay. Final full probe passed. Production code unchanged by this repair.
method.limits: No microphone/acoustic measurement, no live network fault injection, no physical device.
method.https_run: Normal TLS trust; production API and returned audio both HTTPS; fresh sign-in through ordinary simulator UI; cached 40-word excerpt; full native probe passed.
method.verified_run_note: verified_run above predates the final HTTPS migration; https_verified_run is the final network/native measurement.
